design.statement: two functions f g : Int -> Int that both satisfy h(n+2)=h(n)+h(n+1) and agree at 0 and 1 agree at every integer
design.proof_route: integer induction in both directions; forward derives n+2, backward cancels the shared n+1 term from the two recurrence equations
design.strategic_replacement: use recurrence uniqueness instead of separately proving four Int.fib_add sign quadrants
design.why_stronger: one reusable uniqueness theorem reduces Int.fib_add to two base values, two recurrence checks, and integer-ring normalization

inputs.surface_induction: Lean core Int induction API, resolved only during the single compile

next_on_compile: freeze two deterministic exports and two fresh imports before granting recurrence-uniqueness credit
